source: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures (TFF), publicreporting.cftc.gov
what_this_is: Weekly futures positioning split by WHO holds it. The legacy Commitments of Traders report has one 'non-commercial' bucket that mixes hedge funds in with pensions and insurers; this splits them, so a large real-money long and a large hedge-fund short stop cancelling out into a number that looks like nothing.

class_notes.hedge_funds: Leveraged funds — hedge funds and CTAs, the fast money
class_notes.asset_managers: Asset managers — pensions, insurers and mutual funds, the real money
class_notes.dealers: Dealers — the sell side, largely hedging its own book
